objective: maximize cumulative user profit while enforcing verified-publication minimums and minimizing user intervention

hardPublicationPolicy.rule: Expected-profit optimization may choose WHICH qualified products to publish, but must not silently reduce the daily verified-publication minimum or erase carried debt.

pcAvailabilityPolicy.assumption: User normally closes Windows PC after 01:00 JST.
pcAvailabilityPolicy.after0100: Do not classify Windows publisher inactivity alone as an outage. Continue cloud planning, build preparation, queue/state/ledger repair and fallback preparation.

productionRunPolicy.normalCompletion: At least one newly verified public artifact per PC-available production run, and continue with multiple publications when debt/target remains and safe qualified candidates are ready.
productionRunPolicy.blockedCandidate: Diagnose briefly; if strict publication cannot be reached, defer and switch to another qualified candidate rather than ending the run.
nonCompletionEvidence: HTTP/title-only evidence when commerce checks are required

profitRules: Within the hard publication floor, prefer candidates with stronger purchase intent, differentiation, conversion fit and expected net profit.
Do not publish plaintext paid assets to GitHub.
Do not infer public URLs; independently verify them before marking completed or linking funnels.
Use actual sales/message evidence when available; do not invent demand metrics.
Avoid low-value near duplicates; switch to a distinct qualified fallback when needed.
Do not reactivate KDP or LINE without explicit user instruction.

freeAcquisition.rule: A free tool must retain standalone value. Add a paid CTA only when the corresponding paid public URL is independently verified.

MicrosoftStore.status: monitor connected Gmail and repository state when available; do not infer publication
